newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to extend firing ban 45 days - report.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to extend firing ban 45 days - report.

text.p: The Venezuelan government will extend for another 45 days from May 2 a ban on job dismissals, El Nacional quoted Friday Labor Minister Maria Bernardoni as saying.
She justified the measure by the "considerable increase of dismissals in the private sector" but stressed the ban was temporary, the newspaper said.
The government placed a 45-day ban on dismissals on March 19 while a ground-breaking agreement reached last month on severance pay became law. The reform is being studied by Congress.
The firing ban followed concern from some sectors that employers might use the intervening period before the implementation of the new severance pay system to fire workers.
